Inland heat: UC Riverside vs the coast

Southern California at the dataset's native ~4.6 km grid, July 15–16, 2026. The marine layer keeps the coast mild while the Inland Empire bakes. Drag the hour and watch the heat push inland in the afternoon, then the gap close overnight.
